Indikator 4a2 measures the proportion of patients with atrial fibrillation and an indication for anticoagulation therapy who are actively receiving treatment two years after their index date [^src1]. The national standard for this indicator is set at a minimum of 90% [^src1]. Across [[danmark|Danmark]], the overall fulfillment rate stands at 88.6%, meaning the country as a whole currently misses the national target [^src1].

When examining the leaders, [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] achieves the highest compliance rate at 93.8%, followed closely by [[klynge-midt|Klynge MIDT]] at 92.5% and [[randersklyngen|Randersklyngen]] at 91.6% [^src1]. At the regional level, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] (91.1%) and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] (90.4%) successfully meet the ≥90% standard, alongside several other clusters such as [[aarhusklyngen|Aarhusklyngen]] (91.0%), [[horsensklyngen|Horsensklyngen]] (90.4%), [[midtklyngen|Midtklyngen]] (91.1%), and [[klynge-nord|Klynge NORD]] (90.6%) [^src1].

Conversely, the trailers reveal significant shortfalls. [[sundhedsklynge-syd|Sundhedsklynge Syd]] records the lowest proportion at just 84.3%, falling notably short of the target [^src1]. Other underperforming areas include [[sundhedsklynge-byen|Sundhedsklynge Byen]] (86.6%), [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] (86.9%), and [[sundhedsklynge-midt|Sundhedsklynge Midt]] (86.9%) [^src1]. 

Because this comparison is built from a single dated table section, no cross-sectional trend claims can be made regarding improvements or declines over time, though the table does include historical columns for 2020/21 and 2019/20 for reference [^src1]. An outlier in the data is [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]], which not only leads the nation but also shows a relatively wide confidence interval (86.2-98.0) due to its smaller patient population (76 out of 81) compared to larger regions [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner andelen af patienter med atrieflimren og indikation for antikoagulationsbehandling, der modtager behandling 2 år efter indeksdato, på regions- og sundhedsklyngeniveau for Danmark i 2021/22 samt tidligere år, og viser, at flere regioner og klynger opfylder den nationale standard på ≥ 90%, men at Sundhedsklynge Syd har den laveste andel på 84,3%.

- "Gennemsnits-CHA2DS2-VASc-scoren for incidente patienter med atrieflimren i Danmark var 1,75" — see [[clinical-indicators|Clinical Indicator]] ([[danmark|Danmark]]) [^src13]
- "60,21% af de incidente patienter med atrieflimren i Danmark havde en CHA2DS2-VASc-score på ≥2" — see [[clinical-indicators|Clinical Indicator]] ([[danmark|Danmark]]) [^src13]
